description: 新竹市政府資料開放平台防空疏散避難設施資料 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新竹市警察局. 提供市民本市防空疏散避難設施資料包含類別、建築物名稱、電腦編號、村里別、地址、緯度、經度、可容納人數、轄管分局等資訊. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 新竹市警察局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls, csv, xml, json. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
